artworks.title: Embracing Lovers in Classical Dress / A Woman in Classical Dress Looking Up
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, black chalk and white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures embracing on a draped surface. Both individuals have curly hair, are facing the left, and are dressed in flowing garments. They appear to be in an intimate embrace, with one figure looking up and the other gazing at them. The background features drapery and vague shapes in shades of gray and blue.

artworks.title: Scène de Marché au Port de l'Hôtel de Ville, Paris (Market Scene at the Port of the Hôtel de Ville, Paris)
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a cobblestone street market with blurred architecture in the background. The image captures an outdoor market scene with various baskets and market goods spread out in the foreground. There is a small wooden structure in the image that resembles a stall or a kiosk. The background is dominated by tall buildings that appear to be of old European architectural style.

artworks.title: The Corpse (Study for The Dead Christ)
artworks.medium: black chalk on buff paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of a male figure lying on his back. The man is drawn flat with arms resting by his sides, hands partially closed. Details include closed eyes, a mustached face, and short wavy hair. The nude figure demonstrates anatomy through shading and lines. Surrounding the main sketch are smaller studies, including versions of the full body and another focusing on the torso and head. The background is a plain paper surface with handwritten notes and measurements.

artworks.title: A Copse of Trees
artworks.medium: brown and black pen and ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a peaceful wooded area seen from a ground-level perspective. Trees dominate the view, with two tall trees at the center. The artwork features detailed brushwork using stippling and hatching techniques to create texture. The color palette consists of soft earthy tones, hinting at a late afternoon or early evening light. Rocks and branches are scattered in the foreground, with dense foliage framing the scene.

artworks.title: Noah and the Animals Entering the Ark
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with various animals. The image depicts farm animals, including sheep, goats, and dogs, gathered around an elderly figure with a staff. The animals are interacting with each other or with the central figure in a rustic setting. The sketch features fine lines and light shading for texture and depth, especially in the wool of the sheep and the figure's clothing. The background shows a rural environment with outlines representing trees or foliage. Birds are present, adding movement to the scene. The drawing style is classical and detailed, capturing the gentle atmosphere of rural life.

artworks.title: Small Grotesque Head
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting the profile of an older man from the shoulders up. He is facing right with his head slightly tilted upward. The man has distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and long lines around his mouth. His hair is tousled and held back with a cloth or band. He is wearing a textured garment with a visible collar or ruffle. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain. A signature and the date "1622" are etched at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: A Philosopher Shewing an Experiment on the Air Pump
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of individuals gathered around a table with a scientific instrument. The scene is dramatically lit by a single light source, emphasizing the expressions and features of the subjects as they focus intently on an experiment involving a bird in an air pump. The room is filled with a sense of wonder and curiosity, with various characters displaying different reactions to the demonstration. The background includes a large birdcage and a window, suggesting this event takes place in a domestic setting.

artworks.title: A Nude Reclining in a Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person reclining on their side, with one leg extended and the upper body supported by an arm. The person's head is turned slightly to the left, with delicately outlined facial features and hair styled in waves or gentle curls. The individual is unclothed and positioned on a natural landscape with undulating hills or dunes. Surrounding the figure are sketchy outlines of vegetation, likely bushes or trees, filling much of the scene. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held. The background features loosely sketched tree outlines, creating a serene, natural environment.

artworks.title: Hands Holding a Sword and a Tricorn
artworks.medium: charcoal touched with white chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of detailed studies of several hands and emblem designs. The drawing has a brown background with charcoal or pencil sketches focusing on hands and different emblem designs. There are three studies of hands, with two holding a cylindrical object and one resting on another element. These sketches emphasize the shaping and shading of fingers. Below the hand sketches are two emblem designs: one resembling a badge with a shield and star shape, and the other resembling a crown-like form. The artist uses shading to create depth and contrast on the brown surface.

artworks.title: Christ Kneeling in Prayer
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with dark gray wash and white heightening on pink partially prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling on the ground. His right leg is on the ground, left knee is bent forward. His upper body is leaning forward, arms bent with hands gesturing slightly upward. His face is turned slightly to the left, showing a mature individual with a distinct facial structure, beard, mustache, and long hair flowing to his shoulders. He wears loose, draped clothing resembling a robe. The background is plain. Handwritten text in decorative script is at the top of the page.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist, Chartres Cathedral
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund, Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a robed figure with long hair, holding an object in one hand adjacent to his chest and the other resting at waist level. The figure is standing, and the garment has drapery that falls naturally. Below the figure's feet, there is a decorative element resembling a winged creature or a bird. The sculpture is crafted from stone and presents a uniformly grey color with a weathered texture. The statue is on the corner of a building, suggesting it is part of a larger architectural structure, and is shown in a context where it is attached to the masonry. The photograph captures the sculpture on a wall of a tall structure.

artworks.title: Apollo and the Muses on Mount Parnassus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features a group of figures in a dynamic and mythological setting. The central focus shows figures engaged in a scene with musical instruments present. One figure wears a radiant headpiece. The lower part of the composition includes a pool of water with a reclining figure and a horse leaning down towards them. The artwork uses rich brown tones and white highlights on toned paper creating depth and movement. The swirling lines and soft sketches give an ethereal quality to the figures and setting.

artworks.title: Cliffs with a Waterfall at Tivoli
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point view of a landscape with vertical cliffs, a building on the edge of one cliff, and rocky surfaces and vegetation. The pencil drawing includes detailed shading to create depth and texture, using fine lines and hatching for forms and textures. Near the base of the cliffs, there is a hint of water where a waterfall ends. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: An Elderly Man in Classical Drapery
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with stumping on oatmeal paper, squared for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure. The drawing depicts a detailed muscular figure seated on a surface, draped with fabric. The figure's body is outlined with strong lines emphasizing the contours and musculature, particularly the upper body and outstretched arms. The fabric naturally folds around the figure, highlighting the seated posture. The drawing is placed on a grid, indicating it may be a preparatory sketch or study. The medium used seems to be graphite and white chalk on toned paper, providing depth and dimension to the figure.

artworks.title: Young Woman Kneeling and Reaching Forward [verso]
artworks.medium: red and black chalk heightened with white chalk on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crouching or crawling position. The person's upper body is leaning forward and supported by their forearms, while their legs are slightly bent and extended behind them. The person's face is not clearly visible as they are facing downward with long hair covering most of it. The outfit is loose and flowing, with folds indicating a long-sleeved garment and a billowing lower section. There are no accessories or objects visible, and the background is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Two Young Women Seated on the Ground [recto]
artworks.medium: red and black chalks heightened with white chalk on light brown (originally blue) laid paper; squared in black chalk
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of two seated women shown from approximately the waist up, positioned closely together. The woman on the left faces forward and slightly turns toward the woman on the right. She has softly styled hair, refined facial features, and a calm expression, and appears to have pushed sleeves on her garment. The woman on the right is seated with one arm resting on her knee, with a gentle expression and similarly styled hair. She wears draping clothing that suggests the texture and volume of the fabric. Both women are depicted in a loose, sketch-like technique with soft lines and shading, creating a sense of depth and movement. The drawing uses red chalk on light brown paper, with visible lines and marks indicating the contour and shadows of the subjects. In the background, there is a faint suggestion of shading indicating a surface the women might be sitting on. A third hand and partial arm are sketched reaching into the scene from off the page. Numbers and markings are visible near the upper right corner of the paper.

artworks.title: A Field Mouse, from Above
artworks.medium: watercolor with graphite and black pen and ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a small rodent lying on its back. The rodent is depicted with meticulous detail, capturing its soft brown fur with subtle gradations of light and shadow. Its limbs are splayed out to the sides, and its tail extends straight out behind it. The background is a plain, light tan.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure, larger and at the center, stands in shallow water mid-stride while holding a long staff. The figure has a long beard, facial features are prominent, and hair is covered with a head wrap. The person wears a robe, cloak, and has a pouch on the side. A smaller figure, a child, sits on the larger figure's shoulder, holding a small object and depicted with rays from its head. Another hooded figure stands on the shore, looking at the larger figure and holding a staff with a cylindrical item. The background shows a landscape with trees, hills, a sun, moon, and a simple setting.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Woman Dressing
artworks.medium: gray-green chalk
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two partial views of a woman's upper body, from the waist up. On the left side, the woman is shown in profile facing to the right, with her arm bent at the elbow and her hand slightly clenched in front of her chest. Her facial features are minimally sketched, and her hair is styled up with some detail indicating waves or curls. On the right side, the same woman is depicted facing more toward the viewer with her left arm resting on a surface, her hand extending outward. Her facial features are more defined with indications of eyes, a nose, and a mouth, and her hair is similarly styled. She appears to be wearing a sleeveless garment or blouse with a fitted waist. The sketch is monochromatic, executed in pencil on plain paper with a light background. The backdrop is unadorned, focusing solely on the figure sketches.

artworks.title: Duc de Chartres
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows a person dressed in a traditional military uniform. The individual is standing upright, with the body slightly angled and holding onto a long rifle that rests on the floor, with both hands clasped at the front. The person has youthful facial features with short hair mostly obscured by the military cap. The uniform they are wearing includes a long coat, with a belt around the waist, and a cap featuring insignia on the front. A backpack is visible over the shoulders. The background of the photo includes a railing with ornate balusters, set against a plain, softly lit wall.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape with a Waterfall
artworks.medium: gray wash with brown and black pen and ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with hills, a river, lush vegetation, a tree, and a rocky outcrop. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: A Shady Arbor in the Valley of Gragnano
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This sketch depicts a landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint, gently sloping downward. The horizon is high and faint, with hills and distant buildings visible. The artist used fine pencil strokes to capture details of trees, foliage, and rocky terrain. The style is subtle and detailed in a monochrome palette, emphasizing natural elements over man-made structures. The composition features varying textures, shading, and linework to convey depth and form. Closest to the viewer is rugged earth and vegetation, leading to a sheltered area with trees and wooden supports. Shadows and light are shown through line density and cross-hatching. The scene extends into the distance with a backdrop of hills, trees, and buildings.

artworks.title: A Leafy Oak by a Woodland Path
artworks.medium: graphite, black and white chalk, and gray wash on buff paper
artworks.description: The image features a detailed drawing of a large tree viewed from a direct perspective, showcasing its grandiosity. The focus is solely on the tree, suggesting a dense foliage environment. The artist uses textured brushstrokes to depict the tree’s bark and leafy canopy. The branches twist and extend in various directions, giving a sense of movement. Dark shading represents the leaves against a sepia-toned background. The composition is monochromatic with a paper-hued backdrop.

artworks.title: Twelve Roundels with Landscapes
artworks.artist: Laurent Guyot after Jean Henry Alexandre Pernet
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner with roulette on laid paper mounted on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
overall (roundel diameters): 4.2 cm (1 5/8 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 16.6 × 23.1 cm (6 9/16 × 9 1/8 in.)
mount: 24.8 × 32.8 cm (9 3/4 × 12 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul S. Morgan in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image features twelve small circular landscapes on a pastel blue background. Each circle contains a unique scenic view with elements such as buildings, water bodies, trees, and architectural structures. The horizon lines are positioned towards the center of each circle, creating a balanced composition. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, offering a texture that suggests detail. The color palette includes soft tones of ochre, green, and light browns against muted grays, creating a serene visual effect. The scenes depict elements like waterfalls, rivers, and buildings among trees, evoking a quaint charm.
